note: Oil and gas extended their pullback into 9 November: Brent fell to about $96.93/bbl and TTF to about €86.93/MWh, both down roughly 11-14% from a week earlier, as Iraq said it reached understandings with the US to keep exporting through Hormuz via a lane near Oman and traders sought US licenses to return about 50 sanctioned tankers to legitimate trade. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy claimed fresh mine strikes on tankers near the strait on 7 November and Iranian state media suggested that evening's blasts were tied to Iran's own military activity rather than a US strike — claims Reuters could not independently confirm.
